## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive; breadth confirms underlying market health while risk/cycle ratios are neutral (VXX mixed; SPY/TLT neutral), so no clear directional bias. XLK in RECOVERY (1W: +0.74% | 1M: -4.99%) and XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.43% | 1M: +12.93%) illustrate mixed leadership.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Energy strength is a tailwind: BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.18% | 1M: +13.88%) and XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.43% | 1M: +12.93%). Credit and volatility are neutral-to-mixed: HYG CORRECTION (1W: -0.24% | 1M: +0.05%) and VXX CORRECTION (1W: -0.61% | 1M: +7.46%).

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral: TLT ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.19% | 1M: +3.00%) shows bond demand, while LQD CORRECTION (1W: -0.71% | 1M: +0.59%) and HYG CORRECTION (1W: -0.24% | 1M: +0.05%) point to no decisive easing or stress.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Cyclicals leading: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.43% | 1M: +12.93%), XLI ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.33% | 1M: +7.86%), while Tech lagging on the month with XLK in RECOVERY (1W: +0.74% | 1M: -4.99%) — style mixed / no clear leadership.

**5. US vs Global?**
US modestly stronger: SPY RECOVERY (1W: +0.58% | 1M: -1.10%) and QQQ RECOVERY (1W: +1.11% | 1M: -3.39%). EM soft/volatile with EEM CORRECTION (1W: -0.24% | 1M: +1.75%) and FXI BELOW TREND (1W: -4.60% | 1M: -9.51%).

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculative assets showing short-term bounces: IBIT RECOVERY (1W: +7.24% | 1M: -17.66%) and ARKK RECOVERY (1W: +6.03% | 1M: -4.40%), while small caps are strong: IWM ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.27% | 1M: +0.17%).

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Commodity reflation visible: BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.18% | 1M: +13.88%) and USO ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.78% | 1M: +10.17%), copper CPER in RECOVERY (1W: +1.99% | 1M: -5.99%) suggesting cyclical pulse but mixed momentum.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy leadership durable: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.43% | 1M: +12.93%) and BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.18% | 1M: +13.88%); natural gas uneven with UNG RECOVERY (1W: +2.21% | 1M: -20.32%).

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
Confirmed: Broad sector breadth (8/11) and Energy/Industrials ABOVE TREND (XLE, XLI). MAJOR divergence across core risk ETFs — SPY RECOVERY (1W: +0.58% | 1M: -1.10%), QQQ RECOVERY (1W: +1.11% | 1M: -3.39%), XLK RECOVERY (1W: +0.74% | 1M: -4.99%) — treat market as transitional.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor cyclicals and commodity-exposed ETFs such as XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.43% | 1M: +12.93%) and XLI ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.33% | 1M: +7.86%); reduce exposure to China ETF FXI BELOW TREND (1W: -4.60% | 1M: -9.51%) and monitor tech/QQQ RECOVERY (1W: +1.11% | 1M: -3.39%); bonds (TLT ABOVE TREND) remain a neutral hedge.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.43% | 1M: +12.93%) and XLI ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.33% | 1M: +7.86%) if oil stays bid (BNO ABOVE TREND). BEARISH: FXI BELOW TREND (1W: -4.60% | 1M: -9.51%) and XLP CORRECTION (1W: -0.29% | 1M: +8.01%) if defensive flows resume.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.18% | 1M: +13.88%) and USO ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.78% | 1M: +10.17%). BEARISH: SLV RECOVERY (1W: +1.24% | 1M: -22.73%) and UNG RECOVERY (1W: +2.21% | 1M: -20.32%) remain vulnerable on month trends.

**13. Key Levels?**
Watch VXX for complacency swings and volatility risk given VXX CORRECTION (1W: -0.61% | 1M: +7.46%); monitor HYG/LQD spread for credit health with HYG CORRECTION (1W: -0.24% | 1M: +0.05%) and LQD CORRECTION (1W: -0.71% | 1M: +0.59%); XLK vs cyclicals gap (XLK RECOVERY vs XLE ABOVE TREND) for leadership pivot.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive supporting continuation rather than a clear risk tilt. Energy and Industrials showing relative strength (XLE ABOVE TREND, XLI ABOVE TREND); key risk is the MAJOR divergence across core risk ETFs (SPY, QQQ, XLK RECOVERY patterns) — monitor for a leadership shift.
